questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign tells you that a divided highway is starting. You should keep to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: School zone or school crossing sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: School zone or school crossing sign.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign alerts drivers to school zones. This sign warns that children or pedestrians may be crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Round signs warn drivers only about railroad crossings ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a yield sign is coming. Slow down when you see this warning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a flagger is ahead. Always follow the flagger's directions. Flaggers wear bright orange, yellow, or yellow-green clothing. They use paddles and red flags to direct traffic through work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings and alert you to upcoming conditions. This sign warns you that you are leaving a one-way highway and entering a two-way highway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.
Drive no slower than 35 mph around the upcoming curve.
Approach the upcoming curve at a speed of 35 mph or slower.

questions.correctAnswerText: Approach the upcoming curve at a speed of 35 mph or slower.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings and alert you to upcoming conditions. Speed advisory signs show the safe speed to drive through curves or hazards.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop and check for traffic coming from both directions before proceeding.
Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
Maintain a steady speed and check for traffic coming from all directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
questions.explanation: A three-sided yield sign means you must slow down and stop if needed. Let any vehicle, bicyclist, or pedestrian pass first. You do not have the right-of-way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossroad is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.

questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns. You cannot turn right at an intersection where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No turns are allowed on the road.
There is a series of curves ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn you about conditions just ahead. This sign alerts you to a winding road coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn you about conditions just ahead. This sign warns of a curve to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn you about conditions just ahead. This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign means a steep hill is ahead. Slow down and shift to a lower gear to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign is posted where you should not enter. It marks one-way streets and expressway ramps where traffic flows in the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a one-way road, entrance, or exit. If you see this sign ahead, traffic is moving toward you. Turn around immediately.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May turn left or continue straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: May turn left or continue straight.
questions.explanation: This sign shows your lane is splitting into two directions. You can turn left or go straight when in this lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped warning signs alert you to hazards. Orange signs are used for construction and maintenance areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign means stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road will turn sharply right and then sharply left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep downgrade is coming. Check your brakes before descending.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns drivers that bicycles may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.

questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns drivers that pedestrians may cross ahead. Stop and wait until pedestrians have completely crossed the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns you that a traffic signal is ahead at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This orange and red triangle is displayed on the back of slow-moving vehicles like tractors and farm equipment.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns you that the right lane is ending. Be ready for merging traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round sign indicates a railroad crossing ahead. Slow down, look and listen for trains, and be prepared to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location. You will often see this sign where oncoming traffic is heavy.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop every time you see this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns drivers to watch for pedestrians crossing the road ahead.
